n: 21 Cu. Ft. Counter-Depth French Door Refrigerator
desc: Experience the finest in features and design with the Electrolux french door refrigerator. 21.8-cu. ft. of flexible storage space means that you'll have enough room to fit all of your family's favorite foods, big or small, within a seamless counter-depth design. This four door refrigerator features our TasteLock drawers that utilize smart crisper technology to remove excess moisture to prevent produce from spoiling, shriveling, or molding.
hl: Find a place for everything from large platters and cakes to tall wine bottles and beverages with our flexible organization system.
Avoid spoiled food and wasted energy with auto-close doors, which ensure that your refrigerator is never left slightly open by mistake.
Easily fill pitchers and tall sports bottles with our new water and ice dispenser, redesigned to accommodate any container up to 10.5 inches tall.
Get a Built-In Look with Counter-Depth Design
Our counter-depth refrigerator sits flush with existing cabinetry, making it easy to achieve a sleek, built-in look .
Quickly freeze foods so they stay at their freshest - set this option before a large grocery run so your food freezes faster once you get home.
